name: Cloud-Herding Lance (Mục Vân Mâu)
lore: A herder's lance of white elm from Bạch Du Lâm with a horn point, made by the founder Mẫn Bạch Câu in 740 to turn stampedes, not men. It has been carried by the head of the manor at every festival race since, and Khấu Mục Vân has never couched it at anything but a wolf.
build_use: Rider and beast together: Physical hits, a body shield, and a companion that hits harder alongside.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Ram's-Horn Pennant (Dương Giác Kỳ)
lore: The last pennant of Phù Dao Quán, the Abbey of the Whirlwind on the steppe (496), named for the whirlwind that winds up like a ram's horn and carries the great bird ninety thousand li. Thôi Dương Giác took it down from the abbey's pole in the cold year of 1121 (V100) and carried it to the manor with the abbey's book. It has not flown since.
build_use: Wind speed and buffs for the one elder who can use them.
made_by: the masters of Phù Dao Quán

name: Bridle Ring of Đạp Vân (Đạp Vân Bí Hoàn)
effects: Horse and Rider Bear It Together
lore: The silver bridle ring off the halter Đạp Vân wore as a foal, the only halter it ever let on. Khấu wears it on his thumb.
build_use: The horse hits harder and sooner when he does.

name: Herder's Felt Armour (Mục Chiên Giáp)
lore: Plain-felt and horn-plate riding armour of the manor, layered one felt for each festival race the wearer has won. His has thirty-one.
build_use: A body that does not break at the gallop.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Habit of the Whirlwind Abbey (Phù Dao Đạo Y)
lore: The grey habit of Phù Dao Quán, cut so wide that the wind fills it. She is the last who has the right to wear it.
build_use: Evasion and the breath held for the next step.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Well-Digger's Plumb Stone (Tỉnh Truỵ Bội)
lore: Her father's plumb stone from Song Tỉnh Thôn, which found water under the dry steppe twice. She wears it to remember there is ground under the wind.
build_use: The little Earth the manor taught her: a body that stays put when it must.
